copy.tagline_en: Control Home Assistant smart home devices via MCP protocol
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have Home Assistant and want to control devices via MCP

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以控制你的 Home Assistant 智能家居设备（如开关灯、调亮度、调风扇速度），也能查询设备状态。
howto.when: 当你要求控制智能家居设备（如开灯、关风扇）或查询设备状态时触发。

say.note: Claude 会调用 HassTurnOn 打开指定灯。

say.text: 查询家里所有设备的状态。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can control your Home Assistant smart home devices (e.g., turn lights on/off, adjust brightness, set fan speed) and query device states.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to control smart home devices (e.g., turn on a light, turn off a fan) or query device states.

say_en.note: Claude will call HassTurnOn to turn on the specified light.

say_en.text: Set the living room fan speed to 80%.
say_en.note: Claude will call HassFanSetSpeed to set the fan speed.

say_en.text: Query the state of all devices at home.
say_en.note: Claude will call GetLiveContext to get states.
